reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: Section 13.1 extends the subscription access right to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf, closing the affiliate/contractor gap the rule targets.

Section 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, matching the preferred position on paid-up licences.
Section 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation/suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure, so no at-will revocability remains.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and both deterministic checks (affiliate coverage; no at-will revocation) pass.
